canonical_name: Spectral decomposition theorem for Axiom A systems (exact variant open)
leading_candidate_not_credited: Smale 1967, theorem (6.2), printed page 777: an Axiom A diffeomorphism of a compact manifold has a unique finite decomposition of its nonwandering set into pairwise disjoint closed invariant indecomposable pieces on each of which the map is topologically transitive.
statement_blocker: The repository gloss does not decide the diffeomorphism theorem (6.2) versus the flow theorem Part II (5.2), and no independent reviewer has approved the source identity, exact definitions, assumptions, translation, proof boundary, or errata. Selecting either as canonical at intake would overstate source fidelity.
domain_and_universes: Open until source selection: for theorem (6.2), a compact differentiable manifold M, a diffeomorphism f : M -> M, its nonwandering set, tangent bundle and derivative, and a hyperbolic invariant splitting; for theorem Part II (5.2), a compact manifold and continuous-time flow with the source's different Axiom A' conditions.
conclusion: Open canonically. The leading candidate concludes existence and uniqueness of a finite pairwise-disjoint decomposition of the nonwandering set into closed invariant indecomposable pieces, with each restricted map topologically transitive; the flow candidate has a distinct domain and Axiom A' premise.
